title: Using Offers and Rewards Legally
summary: It is permissible to use company rewards and set commissions for payment transfers.
translation: There was a question about whether using offers from companies when recharging, which sometimes include extra money or items without charge, is permissible. There are two perspectives: for personal use and for business when recharging someone else's mobile. In both cases, any commission or reward from the company can be used, as it is considered a gift or reward, and there is no harm in accepting it. Additionally, for transferring money through apps like Google Pay or Phone Pe, it is permissible to take a fixed commission, such as 100 rupees for every 10,000 rupees, for the effort involved; this is entirely permissible according to Shariah and allowed.
